results.description:
CoinCheck is your ultimate tool, designed to satisfy your curiosity and enhance your coin collection experience. Discover the true potential of each coin in your collection and unlock a world of numismatic knowledge with just a snap!

How it works:
1. Snap or Upload: Begin by taking a photo of the coin with your phone camera or uploading an existing image from your gallery.
2. AI Analysis: Our AI technology quickly analyzes the image, comparing it against a comprehensive database to accurately identify the coin.
3. Instant Results: Within moments, receive detailed information about the coin, including its name, origin, year of issue, and other unique characteristics.
4. Valuation: The AI goes a step further to provide an estimated market value, helping you understand the worth of your coin in real-time.

This process is designed to be both intuitive and efficient, making it easy for anyone, from casual enthusiasts to serious collectors, to uncover the rich stories and values of their coins with minimal effort.

Key features:
• Fast and accurate coin recognition
• Know the price and value of your coins
• Identify rare coins
• Extensive information about coins from all over the globe
• Categorize and track your collection
• Up-to-date reference prices
• Easy-to-use interface

CoinCheck is your gateway to the fascinating world of numismatics, suitable for collectors at all levels of expertise. Download now and start discovering the unique stories and values of each coin in your collection.

Subscription pricing and terms:
CoinCheck offers the following auto-renewing subscriptions to provide you with unlimited access to identification and database within Coin Identifier Premium Plan while you maintain an active subscription: Weekly with a 3-day trial at $5.99; Weekly at $5.99; Monthly at $12.99; Yearly with a 3-day trial at $29.99; Yearly at $29.99; Lifetime at $49.99. For other currencies, the price corresponds to the same price tier on the App Store Pricing Matrix.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the application, please do not hesitate to contact us.
